en: Colorized historic view of a railway station with people gathered on the platform and railcars at the tracks. A tree‑lined path and a narrow canal run along the left side, while in the background a conical stone tower and hillside with scattered buildings and cypress trees are visible. The caption at the top right identifies the scene as the Trento railway station and line to Malè.
